business_summary: Toenec Corporation engages in facility construction work in Japan. It operates through Equipment Installation Business, Energy Business, and Other segments. The company engages in the undertaking and carrying out of indoor wiring, air conditioning plumbing, and communication line work; FIT solar power generation business; PPA services; and high-voltage bulk power receiving services. It is also involved in facility management; construction and maintenance of power distribution lines; construction of underground power distribution lines, solar power plants, and distribution routes; air conditioning duct work; installation of indoor electrical equipment, base stations for mobile communications, and air conditioning equipment; laying of optical cables; construction of network systems; information and communication technology solutions; and groundwater utilization services. In addition, the company engages in pipe laying; fire-control system construction; construction and building works; scaffolding, earthworks, and concrete works; road surfacing; painting; waterproofing and waterworks; steel-structure construction; machinery and tool installation; interior finishing work; cleaning-facility construction; electrical communication construction; and manufacture, sale, and leasing of control equipment, lighting equipment, wiring materials, electrical appliances, furniture, kitchen equipment, medical equipment, health and hygiene equipment, home-care devices and goods, fitness equipment, sporting goods, apparel, sundry items, building plant and equipment, air-conditioning equipment, compressors, electrical communication equipment, computer systems, and data terminals. Further, it engages in freight vehicles; sale and management of real estate; investment and financing; manpower dispatching; commodity sales; land, building, and office equipment rental; and non-life insurance agency activities. Toenec Corporation was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 토에넥코퍼레이션은 일본에서 시설공사를 하고 있습니다. 장비 설치 사업, 에너지 사업 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 실내배선, 공조배관, 통신선 공사의 착수 및 시행에 종사합니다. FIT 태양광발전사업 PPA 서비스; 및 고전압 대량 전력 수신 서비스. 시설 관리에도 참여합니다. 배전선 건설 및 유지 관리; 지하 전력 배전선, 태양광 발전소 및 배전 경로 건설; 에어컨 덕트 작업; 실내 전기설비, 이동통신 기지국, 공조설비 설치; 광케이블 부설; 네트워크 시스템 구축; 정보 통신 기술 솔루션; 지하수 활용 서비스. 또한 회사는 파이프 부설 사업에도 종사하고 있습니다. 사격 통제 시스템 구축; 건설 및 건축 작업; 비계, 토공사 및 콘크리트 작업; 도로 표면화; 그림; 방수 및 상수도; 강철 구조물 건설; 기계 및 도구 설치; 인테리어 마감작업; 청소 시설
